title: Darkspear Strand
wikitext:
[[image:Darkspear_Strand.jpg|thumb|Darkspear Strand]]

The [[Darkspear Strand]] {{coords|55|81|Durotar}} is where the [[Darkspear]] [[trolls]] arrived upon their evacuation of the [[Echo Isles]]. Just yards away from the strand sits [[Sen'Jin Village]], where the trolls gathered after fleeing the islands.
